name: Signal Slam
summary: A hazard-orange field where one black Archivo word slams full-frame per spoken word, each at its own width, with stacks, ink bands and a shutter that closes to black. Built for hooks and hype.
suits: hype beats inside a darker video

palette.use: the field: full frame, brightened ~12% at the centre
ink blocks: inverted keywords, bands, the shutter
every slam word, labels, the readout
corner labels and the line strip (ink at about 70% over the field, derived)
the diagonal hatch engraving (16%, 9 px pitch)
the centre glow pulse on the final word
the bone flash on hits; type on the ink shutter (proposed)

type.emphasis: width 125 and the glow pulse, or an ink block with orange type

banned: more than one word on screen in the slam beat (stacks and bands are their own beats, 2–5 words)
lowercase or a second typeface for slam words
easing in: every word arrives already big and settles in 0.16 s
fades between words: hard cuts only, one per spoken word
colours other than signal orange, ink, the hatch and the ember glow
beats longer than about 5 s: it is an interlude, not a whole video
smooth width animation: widths step through the font's instances
